description: Use when auditing, documenting, reorganizing, or validating the current architecture of W.Alter and its Oracle Ubuntu ARM64 VM, including instance resolution, Walter modules, services, projects, applications, storage, runtimes, and compatibility paths.
reason: The session established a recurring, multi-step procedure for auditing and consolidating Walter on its Oracle Ubuntu ARM64 VM: resolve /instances/monsieur, inventory Walter modules and systemd services, inspect PostgreSQL/network/runtimes, move projects to /srv/projects and apps to /srv/apps while retaining /root/projects compatibility links, archive unused scripts and root material, ingest personal files into the deduplicating Raw Vault, update decision records, and validate services and endpoints. It also captured hard-won pitfalls: stale paths in Hermes configuration, the need to verify /proc/<pid>/cwd, preserving reversible archives, not deleting 1.9 GB of copies without approval, and treating timed-out orchestration hooks as unexecuted until independently verified.
